title: SDE II - Backend
description:
We are looking for an SDE II to join the supply platform team.

Responsibilities:
- Build backend services in Node.js or Java that power seller onboarding.
- Model data in PostgreSQL and keep read paths fast as volume grows.
- Work with product to turn vague requirements into shipped REST APIs.
- Take part in on-call for the services you own.

What we look for:
- 3-5 years of backend engineering experience.
- Solid SQL and data modelling.
- Familiarity with AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Bias toward small, reversible changes.

Bonus: experience with Redis, or with high-write systems.
